description: Printable hinge leaf with pin bore and knuckle clearance
description_en: Printable hinge leaf with pin bore and knuckle clearance
manufacturing_notes: Use at least 0.3 mm clearance around hinge pin
Orient hinge so pin bore is printable
Avoid fully captured print-in-place hinge unless requested
failure_modes: Coaxial cuts fail if knuckles are not unioned first
Insufficient pin clearance fuses moving parts
code:
import cadquery as cq
import math

# [Hinge]
# [Dimension]
leaf_length_mm = 60  # [30:1:120]
# [Dimension]
leaf_width_mm = 28  # [16:1:60]
# [Dimension]
leaf_thickness_mm = 4  # [2:0.5:8]
# [Dimension]
knuckle_diameter_mm = 10  # [6:0.5:18]
# [Dimension]
pin_hole_diameter_mm = 4.4  # [2:0.1:10]

leaf = cq.Workplane("XY").box(leaf_length_mm, leaf_width_mm, leaf_thickness_mm)
knuckle = cq.Workplane("YZ").cylinder(leaf_length_mm, knuckle_diameter_mm/2).translate((0, leaf_width_mm/2, leaf_thickness_mm/2))
result = leaf.union(knuckle)
pin_cut = cq.Workplane("YZ").cylinder(leaf_length_mm + 2, pin_hole_diameter_mm/2).translate((0, leaf_width_mm/2, leaf_thickness_mm/2))
result = result.cut(pin_cut).faces(">Z").workplane().pushPoints([(-leaf_length_mm/4, 0), (leaf_length_mm/4, 0)]).hole(3.4)
show_object(result)
